goal: Catch FreeBSD-specific regressions in PR CI by replacing cross-compilation with native builds and tests
agreement: Broad concept support for running native BSD tests in PR CI (fanquake, hebasto, pinheadmz, vasild, winterrdog)
Unaddressed objection: rsync caching operations are very flaky (hebasto)
Contested choice: prefers ZFS over UFS to test paths where posix_fallocate is missing (hebasto)
Withdrew objection over nested VM brittleness and noise, agreeing to test and revert if needed (maflcko)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it catches FreeBSD regressions before merge rather than relying on noisy nightly runs
The benefit is limited to platform-specific testing without directly affecting release binaries

categories.name: tests
why: P4 because the framework change only silences benign lsof memory allocation warnings on FreeBSD
The test framework adjustment is minor and incidental to the new CI job
